mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS activeUserCount, COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS avgPurchaseFrequency, ( SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG(age_group, cnt) FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '18-25' WHEN age BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN '26-35' WHEN age BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45' ELSE '45+' END AS age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cnt FROM shopping_record WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY age_group ) t ) AS ageGroupDistribution, ( SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG(gender, cnt) FROM ( SELECT gender, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cnt FROM shopping_record WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY gender ) t ) AS genderDistribution, ( SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG(location, cnt) FROM ( SELECT location, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cnt FROM shopping_record WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY location ) t ) AS locationDistribution FROM shopping_data WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS salesCount FROM shopping_data WHERE date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT category AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM shopping_data GROUP BY category
SELECT item_purchased AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM shopping_data GROUP BY item_purchased ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT color AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM shopping_data GROUP BY color ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT size AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM shopping_data GROUP BY size ORDER BY value DESC
